hypothesis: External learned links can fill unambiguous baseline track breaks without replacing its detector or existing links.
coordinate_matching: Mutual nearest neighbors within each frame, uniquely nearest in both directions, at most 3.0 micrometers; reject ties
radius_provenance: Reuse the earlier frozen FOCUS bridge 3.0 micrometer duplicate-exclusion radius; no radius sweep
edge_rule: One-frame external nondivision link, both endpoints matched to baseline nodes; baseline source has no outgoing edge, target has no incoming edge; reject proposal conflicts
promotion_gate: Diagnostic positive pooled score delta, no per-movie adjusted-edge regression, at least one correct added link and zero added false links; passing does not authorize submission
validation_scope: Four already-open base-training diagnostic movies only
